title: WritePreview
description: What a write would do for a job's diff right now (GET/POST /jobs/:id/write-preview). Single source of truth - the orchestrator computes it (orchestrator/src/modules/pipeline/write-plan.ts buildWritePreview, the same select* functions confirm() uses) and the TS types are generated from this file (shared/ts, `pnpm generate`); the frontend only phrases these numbers and re-implements no write rule. Checked against buildWritePreview's output keys by orchestrator/test/write-preview.contract.spec.ts.

createdLocalIds.description: The local ids of the items that will be created, so a caller can relate its own per-item facts (such as how each was reviewed) to the write.

excluded.description: Entries the reviewer excluded, and entries dropped because an ancestor was excluded.

parentLinks.description: New parent links that will be written.

existingGettingChildren.description: Distinct existing parents (resolved to an ADO id by this job's reuse/dedup_skip) of entries that get a new parent link. A resumed-only parent is not counted.

existingWithoutNewParentLink.description: Non-excluded entries that resolved to an existing ADO id AND have a parent. A root existing entry is not counted.

traceLinks.description: Trace links: written, and declared but not written (target excluded, not created, or unresolved).

alreadyWritten.description: Non-excluded items of this job already in Azure DevOps from an earlier attempt. Deliberately NOT limited to the current selection.

figuresToAttach.description: Figure attachments confirm() would still upload (figures whose file is still stored, on items this job creates or resumes).

figuresUnavailable.description: Figures of entries this job creates that have no stored file (failed to store, or removed by retention), so they will not be attached.

hasWork.description: Whether a write would do anything at all: create, link, trace-link or attach. Computed by the server (planHasWork).

figuresOnly.description: Only figures are left: nothing is created and no link is added, but figures are still attached to their items. Computed by the server.
